physical_identity: release asset filename + colon + exact archive member path; item_id=p_+SHA256(UTF8 physical_identity); raw/version hash retained separately
selection: 10 per category basic, semantic by ascending SHA256(salt+UTF8 question_id), ties ID; all matching gold physical documents then remaining physical identities in that same hash order to exactly500
rendering: UTF8 .txt body already contains title: Go TrimSpace, remove initial BOM, CRLF/CR to LF. corpus title empty; text full normalized body; no duplicated title, truncation or content filtering. All routes receive the same bytes.
intended_arms: mousa original/dedup traced limit100 budgets1024/4096 engine packing original
stdlib SQLite FTS5 unicode61 remove_diacritics2 whole-document BM25 OR quoted alphanumeric terms order score ASC, physical item ID ASC; unique IDs
optional QMD pinned lexical search --json --full -n100 only; setup <=300s/256MiB lifecycle scripts off

metrics.packing: separate engine-produced selected-gold-document coverage at1024/4096 bytes; not semantic evidence sufficiency
metrics.gain: 1 for original expected_doc_ids mapped to unambiguous physical items; nonlabels are not invented negative judgments

bound_failure: Freeze entire selected membership and per-question failure. Do not ingest, query, truncate, reduce membership, score zero or replace questions. QMD setup is unnecessary if global preparation fails. Reproduce preparation, not a smaller run.
limitations: generated/simulated company, not private production documents
gold-enriched reduced corpus removes most official distractors; descriptive development pilot only
not answer-generation/judge/full-corpus/leaderboard evaluation; no paid APIs or models
no policy changes in response to scores; fresh untouched data and preregistered comparison needed for confirmation
